free_tier.stated: Notice: from 22 May 2020 the free edition no longer limits traffic and becomes a free three-day trial. [translated]

egress.terms: Unlimited traffic, but only for three days: the free edition became a three-day trial in May 2020 and the paid ladder starts at CNY 528 with 2 Mbps.; ingress: udp

interface_detail: A client for local servers and NAS, a web console for mappings and mesh groups, and an optional hardware box.
tooling: vendor client on a local server or NAS, or the vendor's hardware box; wg-quick on the local box
chaining: A three-day window is enough to test a WG-over-UDP path end to end before deciding whether the paid tier is worth CNY 528.

limits.value: 2 Mbps on the cheapest paid tier at CNY 528

binding_note: No kind in the seven-value vocabulary fits what ends the free rung: a three-day wall clock. The trial carries unlimited traffic and an unstated bandwidth, so neither a byte counter nor a shaper can be shown to bind. The wall clock needs no vocabulary to be decisive.

identity_cost.detail: Not established: the page offers free registration and an enterprise quote line, but the registration fields were not read. The vendor is a mainland company selling to enterprises on a 400 number.

reliability_note: Reconnect times are published per tier, from 30 seconds on the cheapest to 5 seconds on the flagship, which is a statement about how often the link drops.
confidence_note: The trial notice and the paid ladder are in the page HTML read today. Whether the trial is still granted in 2026 needs a registration to confirm; the notice is dated 2020 and nothing on the page supersedes it.

evidence.proved: free edition became a 3-day trial with no traffic limit on 2020-05-22; paid tiers CNY 528 to CNY 1583, all unlimited traffic, 2 to 6 Mbps
claims compatibility with everything above TCP/UDP and offers a dedicated public IP product

notes: The nearest thing to a host that sells a public address with no byte cap: every paid tier says unlimited traffic and the shaping is what you buy. The free rung is three days. An enterprise virtual-line product with a dedicated public IP is advertised without a public price.

extras.wg_detail: The vendor states compatibility with every application above TCP/UDP, so a WG datagram can ride a UDP mapping. No WG config is issued.
extras.volume_stated: Unlimited traffic, but only for three days: the free edition became a three-day trial in May 2020 and the paid ladder starts at CNY 528 with 2 Mbps.
extras.transit_note: Vendor clusters of 30 to 180 servers on 3 to 7 lines carry the tunnel.
